units.source_text: 宗助散步，习惯从植物园出来，沿着鸭川岸边再登高一点。

en.t: When Sosuke went for a walk, he usually came out of the botanical garden, followed the bank of the Kamo River, and climbed a little higher.

units.source_text: 这样可以眺望北山的景色。

en.t: From there he could look out over the scenery of Kitayama.
He generally took these walks alone.
